tiers.name: Per-Rank In-Memory `np.random.permutation(5B)` `int64` Index Array (8 Ranks/Node)
tiers.note: Each of the 8 ranks allocates 5B x 8B = 40.0 GB for the shuffled index array (320 GB/node!), triggering host cgroup OOM!

tiers.name: Rank-0 Pre-Written `.idx` Shuffle File on Lustre + Unbounded `mmap` Page Cache
tiers.note: Shares the 40GB index via mmap, but random reads across 20TB `.bin` files fill Linux Page Cache and trigger kswapd stalls!

tiers.name: Two-Level Shard + Local 100K-Sample Ring-Buffer Shuffle (`IterableDataset`)
tiers.note: Low memory (2.4 GB), but only shuffles locally within a small window rather than true global dataset permutation.

tiers.name: `O(1)` 4-Round Cycle-Walking Feistel Cipher Global Permutation + `mmap` `MADV_DONTNEED`
tiers.note: Computes exact bijective global index perm(i, seed) in O(1) registers (0 GB index array, 0.08s init) and drops read-once mmap pages!
